where_q_enters.univariate_rsample: eps = |z|**(2/q - 1) * z for q != 2 ; eps = z for q == 2
where_q_enters.consequence: the inter-layer latent is a non-linear q-warp of the Gaussian latent, so the COMPOSED predictive mean is q-dependent; at q==2 the branch is skipped so the q=2 arm is the same architecture and code path
where_q_enters.caveat: this resample is mean-field: it uses only inputs.mean and inputs.variance (the scale-matrix diagonal per the Task-B audit), not the full latent covariance
